verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a collaborative work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a whiteboard or canvas capability. References to 'boards' and custom board views describe monday's work-tracking boards and developer extension points, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
